outcome_evidence: The oven is closed at frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot approaches the handle and pulls the door outward, with opening visible by frames 80–100 in image. The door continues moving away from the oven through frames 130–390; frames 392–399 in image and wrist_image show the door open and the oven interior exposed. Movement is slow but task-directed, with no clearly observed failed acquisition, collision, or unintended object displacement.
